text: Before I reuse this for October, I realized a bank export can contain an entire quarter. Our CLI currently sums every date. Add a --month YYYY-MM option so I can safely produce a report for one month from a mixed-month export. Keep text, JSON and CSV working, exact cents, and the current invalid-row warnings. Use a separate mixed-month fixture to prove September stays correct and October excludes September; leave the original reimbursement source untouched. Update the handoff with the actual command and verify the results.

One important correction while you work: a malformed date must not silently disappear because the month filter skips it. Report the source line on stderr and use the same partial-report exit code 2, while continuing valid rows. Please test an impossible date as well as a malformed --month argument.

I only need October food for the next import. Can --month combine with --category FOOD and --csv? Run that exact combination on the mixed-month sample and show me the import rows and the command I should use. Explain whether any rejected-row warnings still need attention; keep the reply short.
